# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v2.3.1

这是一个补丁版：**只做性能与实现层面的优化，使用方式完全不变。**

上一版把长文编辑搬进了大编辑窗口，这一版回头把那条链路的开销清了一遍——尤其是"每个按键一次强制重排"这笔一直存在的隐性成本。

## 主要更新

- **窗口内的编辑框不再自动计算高度**：它本来就填满窗口、内容超出后自己滚动，所以每个按键省掉一次 `scrollHeight` 读取（会触发强制同步布局）。同时彻底去掉了"先把高度塌成 `auto` 再量"这一步——那一步会带来宽度变化、文本重排和高度算错，是前面几轮反复出问题的根源之一。长文现在由编辑框自身滚动，右侧会出现它自己的滚动条。
- **光标落点不再创建"量尺"输入框**：改为在窗口打开后用真实的编辑框换算点击坐标（元素数为零、只读一次布局），不再插入临时节点扰动文档；并保留"少数环境不返回输入框光标位置时按行高估算"的兜底，落点不会因为一次读取失败而掉到末尾。
- **输入时不再全量重设窗口属性**：以前每次按键和每次上传进度变化都会把七个属性无条件重设一遍（其中图片行还要全量扫描正文），现在只在真的变化时同步，省掉多余扫描与子组件重渲染。
- **顺带清理**：内联编辑器移除后遗留的一整套同步机制（编辑框节点与已同步值记录、挂载动作、落点计划、恒为空转的同步块）全部删除，`XingzhouApp.svelte` 净减约 150 行。

## 没有变化的部分

保存、取消、**点窗口外＝保存**、本地草稿兜底、拼音输入不抖动、⌘Z 可撤销——全部与 2.3.0 一致。

## 升级说明

无需手动迁移：工作项、执行切片、生活节律、Checklist 与营养数据的结构均未变化，读写、修订号、轮换备份与写后复核流程保持原样。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v2.3.1/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v2.3.1

A patch release: **performance and implementation only — nothing about how you use it changes.**

The previous version moved long-form editing into the large editor window; this one goes back over that path and clears out its overhead, especially the hidden "one forced reflow per keystroke" cost that had been there all along.

## Highlights

- **The window's textarea no longer computes its own height.** It already fills the window and scrolls once the content outgrows it, so every keystroke no longer reads `scrollHeight` (which forces a synchronous layout). The "collapse to `auto`, then measure" step is gone as well — that step caused a width change, a text reflow, and a mis-measured height, and was one of the root causes behind several earlier rounds of trouble. Long notes now scroll inside the editor, with their own scrollbar on the right.
- **Placing the caret no longer creates a "measuring" textarea.** The click point is converted against the real editor once the window is open (no extra element, one layout read), so no temporary node is inserted into the document. The fallback that estimates the line from line height is kept for environments that do not report a textarea caret position, so a single failed read can never drop the caret at the very end.
- **Typing no longer reassigns all window props.** Every keystroke and every upload-progress tick used to reassign seven props unconditionally (with the image rows re-scanning the whole text); they are now synced only when they actually change, removing a redundant scan and a child re-render.
- **Cleanup along the way.** The whole synchronisation mechanism left behind by the removed inline editor (editor node and last-synced value records, the mount action, the caret plan, and an effect block that had become a no-op) is deleted, shrinking `XingzhouApp.svelte` by roughly 150 lines.

## What did not change

Saving, cancelling, **click outside saves**, the local draft fallback, pinyin input that no longer jumps, and ⌘Z undo all behave exactly as in 2.3.0.

## Upgrading

No manual migration: the shape of work items, execution slices, life rhythm, checklist, and nutrition data is unchanged, and reading, writing, revision numbers, rotating backups, and write-then-verify all behave as before.

## Download

Download `package.zip` from this release's assets. Do not use GitHub's auto-generated "Source code" archives as a SiYuan plugin package.
